description: Realistic session with three findings: an exact-repeat loop, a silent reversion of the async migration, and an asserted-unverified cache edit. The npm test at step 16 shares the loop signature but is excluded by the state-change suppression (edit at step 14).

findings.note: Bash{npm test} repeats 3x (steps 5, 7, 9) with identical failures and no intervening state change. Step 16 must NOT extend this finding.
Edit at step 14 restores config.ts to its pre-step-3 state; agent text at step 18 ('cleaned up') does not acknowledge a revert.
Cache TTL edit followed by a success assertion ('should work correctly now') and session end, with no verification-shaped action.
